title: Gestational Trophoblastic Disease
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTDs) are a group of rare premalignant and malignant diseases characterized by their origin in trophoblastic cells.

blocks.text: Premalignant forms are complete hydatidiform mole (CHM), partial hydatidiform moles (PHM), and atypical placental site nodules (APSNs).
Malignant forms are called gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) and include invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT).
